status: Stopped after six qualified ordinary windows: no established CPU benefit at 17 terminals; remaining WebGPU single-terminal windows and all four rolling-output traces canceled by coordinator direction. Single-terminal no-regression guard and output callback reduction remain unestablished.
method: Four native/xterm pairs per condition, balanced renderer order. Conditions are separate browser sessions. Before/after differences and ratios of medians are descriptive cross-session comparisons, not same-session paired speedups. Per-run p50 is the even-sample median; p95 is nearest rank. CPU process-type percentages use the recorded midpoint-to-midpoint CDP window. GPU-process CPU is CPU consumption, not hardware GPU time. Compositor presentation acknowledgement is not optical or physical-vsync latency.
